author: CoolVision
description:
Mongolia is one of the wildest countries I've ever explored. From the endless steppes and towering sand dunes of the Gobi Desert to remote nomadic communities and the modern capital of Ulaanbaatar.

I spent nearly two weeks traveling across Mongolia, exploring ancient monasteries, visiting nomadic families, riding horses, encountering wild animals, and discovering how people live in one of the least densely populated countries on Earth.

Along the way, I experienced traditional Mongolian hospitality, stayed in gers (traditional Mongolian yurts), met families raising Bactrian camels, watched herders working with their yaks, and visited the famous Flaming Cliffs, where some of the world's first widely recognized dinosaur eggs were discovered.

**PLACES VISITED IN THIS VIDEO:**

📍 **Ulaanbaatar (Ulan Bator)** — Mongolia's capital, modern architecture, Soviet-era buildings, traditional ger districts, local markets, and everyday city life.

title: MONGOLIA: The Wildest Country I've Ever Explored
